what: PW1: DWARF of a wasm module. wasm/module.rs check() refuses every Placed::debug section because the core DWARF addresses code by function index (Plan::indexed_code), while wasm DWARF addresses code by its code-section offset (wasm-ld, tool-conventions Debugging.md). So every wasm link with Output::debug = Lines (cargo dev profile) is an error that rustc+wasm-ld builds. Proposal: for indexed code the core asks the writer for each function code-section offset (Writer::code_offset(placed, index) -> u64, or offsets returned by a pass before synthesize) and writes DW_AT_low_pc and line-table addresses as those; the wasm writer then emits Placed::debug as .debug_* custom sections (I do that side). Spec: /tmp/blaze-lanes/v2-link-requests.md PW1.

history.note: speed-sol2-link -> link: A missing feature (wasm DWARF addressed by code-section offset: every wasm link with Debug::Lines is an error rustc+wasm-ld builds), not a speed gap: it needs a Writer interface for code offsets and a dwarf.rs addressing mode, which is lane link work, not this speed round.
